latitude.markdownDescription:
Latitude

Degrees north, -90 to 90. Four decimal places (~11 m) is plenty;
nothing here is improved by more, and the value ends up in config
backups.
latitude.title: Latitude

elevation.markdownDescription:
Elevation above sea level (m)

Lowers the horizon: 110 m moves sunrise about two minutes earlier in
central Europe. Leave at 0 if you do not know it.
elevation.title: Elevation

location.description: Geographic location of the controller. Required for sun-based conditions and for the sunrise/sunset times shown in the panel.
location.title: Location
